description: List entities, optionally filtered by a sphere (center+radius), entity type ids, living-only, and whether to include players. Returns position, type, name, health and key flags for each.

center.description: Center of the search sphere; omit to use the position of the only player in that dimension (the world spawn when there is none or several; centerSource says which).

dimension.description: Dimension id, e.g. "minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether". Defaults to the current/overworld dimension.

types.description: Entity type ids to match, e.g. ["minecraft:zombie","minecraft:cow"].

name: query_entities
title: Query entities
